display_name: 条件流与 DURA 的完整 Phase3 系统延迟对照
description: 仅待 E30 固定预测和评分完成后，在同 GPU 用两条合成 G10 输入比较完整 G+F0+E0+PCD+密度阈值计算；不读目标 IQ 或真值。

data.representation: Exactly two deterministic synthetic G10 signals, repeated to batch 1 and 128; no real IQ or truth reads

permissions.regime: Frozen same F0/E0/PCD/density/threshold and original DURA vs fixed E30 flow; synthetic benchmark only
permissions.claim_scope: Hardware-specific timing of fixed already-evaluated systems; no new quality, target generalization, registration or blind-test claim; PCD target-U ancestry disclosed

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen scratch-trained E30 flow vs original DURA graph; same original F0, E0, PCD, density and thresholds
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact E30 completed Phase3 prediction identity, runtime path, checkpoint and F0/E0/PCD ancestry
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed E30 trained with source F0 guidance; baseline F0 source E50 and PCD historical target-U576 ancestry; no parameter changes
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final E30 and DURA; all timing cases reported; no target-dependent choice

metric_names: full G+F0+E0+PCD+CPU density and threshold median and p95 latency

rows.method: Same frozen Phase3 systems with synthetic G10 inputs; original DURA graph vs E30 conditional-flow eager
rows.seed_notes: fixed G10 synthetic phases and canonical channel seeds; same exact arrays to both pipelines
rows.scenario: two deterministic synthetic observations repeated to batch sizes 1 and 128

notes: Full-system timing includes host input conversion, G, F0, E0, PCD, host output conversion and fixed CPU source-density/threshold scores. Loading, capture/setup and queue excluded.
